impact_scope.description: S1 introduces the public xxhash32 hasher update entry point, accepting caller-supplied byte slices and maintaining incremental hashing state.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration in the selected source file; the public xxhash32 hasher.update_u32! unit did not exist.
S1 declares pub struct hasher implementing base.hasher_u32 and pub func hasher.update_u32!(x: roslice base.u8).
H0 enables only BASE and GIF modules and exercises a GIF image decoder; it neither enables xxhash32 nor constructs or calls the new hasher with fuzz input.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must enable the xxhash32 module and add a path that constructs the new hasher and supplies fuzz-controlled bytes to hasher.update_u32!.
evidence: The new public callable requires a caller-supplied byte slice.
No S0 action could expose this exact callable because its declaration was absent.
The existing GIF decoder path does not reach the xxhash32 hasher.

reason: For the anchored public hasher.update_u32! unit, Gap(S0,H0) is false because the unit was absent, while Gap(S1,H0) is true because the unchanged GIF-only harness does not enable or invoke it. This creates a concrete new caller-visible harness obligation and therefore is NEW.
